announce.description: Show the toon publicly before it is published (owner 2026-10-01): the landing page's tile and the main menu list it as "bald" / "soon" (not clickable, no dates, no chapters). Language-neutral.

tile.description: The landing page's tile (language-neutral); without it the tile uses the toon's avatar

cover.description: language-neutral (in the toon entry, owner 2026-10-01): text-free artwork, the title is rendered by the UI (`Cover.lettering`)

sourceLanguage.description: The language the toon is written in; every other language is a translation of it. Default: `languages[0]`, else the first `i18n` key, else `de`.

languages.description: Every language of the toon, the source first. Default: the `i18n` keys (source first).

announced.description: Library answer only (`/library/toons`): the toon is not published but announced (`announce`) – list it as "soon", never link it (its pages stay 404 publicly)

ToonIndex.description: One toon's entry in `toons.json` (language-neutral). The creator keeps the newest version of it in the content store as `<toon>/_/index.json` (see `TOON_INDEX_FILE`); read the languages with `toonLanguages()`.

ToonMapView.description: The toon's start view on the world map (`toon:<toon>` → `map`; language-neutral)

image.description: image path in the toon's CDN folder (`../characters/<id>/…` for a registry portrait), e.g. the star's neutral portrait

color.description: CSS colour behind the image; default: the colour of the toon's star in the character registry (`own_toon`)

ToonTile.description: A toon's tile on the landing page: a square image on a colour

lettering.description: the image is lettering-free: the UI renders the title over it (default false = shown as it is). `true` = the default layout (the toon's name small, the season's title big in quotes); an object = a layout per format from the creator's cover editor (`CoverLettering`, cover.ts) – texts from the text fields, never baked

Cover.description: A toon's / season's cover (language-neutral, owner 2026-10-01: media are shared by all languages). The artwork carries no text: with `lettering` the UI sets the title lines over it in the reader's language (`CoverArt` in `@scutoons/reader`, agents/DATA.md "Language-independent media"). Without it the image is shown as it is – for artwork that still has its title baked in (catpope until the lettering-free cover is delivered).

CoverLettering.description: a layout per format; a format without lines uses the default layout

text.description: the text: the toon's title, the season's title, or `custom`

custom.description: the line's own text per language (only with `text: 'custom'`), e.g. { de: "Staffel 1", en: "Season 1" }

x.description: the centre of the line's box in % of the cover's width

y.description: the centre of the line's box in % of the cover's height

size.description: font size in % of the cover's width (the lettering scales with the art)

maxWidth.description: the line's box width in % of the cover's width: a longer text (a translation) shrinks to fit it

rotate.description: degrees, negative = tilted up to the right like the hand-lettered catpope cover

align.description: the text inside its box (default center)

CoverLine.description: One line of lettering. Geometry is language-neutral; the text comes from a text field (never baked).

Language.description: Content languages (a toon's `languages`); ISO 639-1. Korean is `ko` (2026-10-02, was the unused country code `kr`).
